question: Two categories score zero until the location of an observation is taken into account. Which of the two finishes with the better result? Use the appendix comparison accompanied by three pairs of world maps.

In an analysis covering five model sizes, the stages visited during learning are used to identify unusually weak runs. Why does success on complete trajectories not yet provide a practical way to abandon a run early? State how much of a run the reported predictor actually needs to observe.

Which activation-and-normalization setting would you choose if it must converge, be no slower than the divergent setting, and beat the slower convergent setting on top-one accuracy? The three-way ablation keeps the parameter count fixed; the paper's sole author identifies as an independent researcher. Specify where normalization is applied relative to the projection.

How does the transfer procedure handle an example longer than the original input once its sampling interval has been aligned, in the design that joins contextual features from two independently masked streams before feeding separate output heads?

Enabling both components does not uniformly beat enabling just the right-hand component: one row group improves on ordinary inputs but loses slightly on deliberately altered ones. Find this exception in the ablation with four dataset/backbone groups and two checkbox columns. Which dataset and backbone form the counterexample?

Across four backbones, removing the final spatial averaging operation makes all reported errors cluster near the same high value. Why does keeping this extra local detail cause learning to fail in the procedure that alternates between bringing two views into correspondence and making their appearances comparable?

Two rows of an appendix illustration use red boxes in the leftmost view to locate the areas shown in two sharper views and their labels to the right. Why did the data-construction process retain the extra area outside those boxes? Give both stated reasons.

Silent video is converted into writing. Two supplementary panels compare whether responses use the requested language and whether responses are blank. After adding text-only training in both directions with English, which target language improves most on the former measure among those with no blank responses?

The supplement shows two rows of five colored grids with a three-curve plot at the upper right. Only the solid curve rises, falls, and rises across the four plotted observations. Which measurement does it represent, after the different representations have been rescaled to comparable ranges?

Using the comparison of four conditions and its setup description, calculate the ratio of the common preloading to the load label on the curve whose highest point remains on the negative side of the horizontal axis.
